Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia with slightly decreased hemoglobin, hematocrit, and erythrocyte count. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and platelet distribution width are elevated, suggesting increased platelet turnover or activation. Further evaluation for underlying causes of anemia and platelet changes is recommended.
